verdict: GBP engagement dropped sharply this week; no paid channels are active.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals — your Google Business Profile listings produced 407 combined actions this period (calls, direction requests, and website clicks), which is your only trackable commercial signal right now, as no paid advertising is running on Meta or Google. Over the last 7 days, GBP engagement fell sharply across all three locations — down 38%, 58%, and 76% respectively versus the prior 7 days — with all three profiles recording zero actions on October 16–18, a confirmed stall rather than normal variation. Search Console clicks are also declining across the group, most notably at O'Hare where clicks dropped from a prior average of roughly 24 per day to near zero by October 18. We are actively working to reindex your three sites and restore organic visibility, with that milestone targeted for October 31. Several CRM and outreach milestones that underpin pipeline tracking and contact sequences are past due and are being resolved as the immediate priority so that when activity recovers, it is fully visible in your pipeline.
